entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Manjula Anagani stands as a preeminent Indian obstetrician and gynaecologist, celebrated for her pioneering contributions to minimally invasive gynaecological surgery and her ardent advocacy for women's reproductive health in the late 20th and early 21st centuries. Practicing primarily in Hyderabad, India, Dr. Anagani has revolutionized the treatment of complex gynaecological conditions, significantly improving patient outcomes through advanced laparoscopic techniques. Her work has not only pushed the boundaries of surgical possibility in India but has also profoundly influenced public discourse on uterine preservation and alternatives to hysterectomy, establishing her as a pivotal figure in modern Indian medicine.

Throughout her distinguished career, Dr. Anagani has achieved numerous surgical milestones, including the removal of one of the largest fibroids (over 10 kg) laparoscopically and performing complex procedures such as total laparoscopic hysterectomy for large uteri, which were traditionally managed with open surgery. She has conducted over 10,000 laparoscopic surgeries, demonstrating exceptional skill and dedication to reducing patient morbidity and recovery times. Her technical prowess and innovative approach have positioned her as a leader in endoscopic surgery, training countless other surgeons across India and beyond in these advanced methods.
